### Avg Weekly Hours (Manufacturing) [...] Consumer spending power. Adjusted for seasonal patterns but not inflation.

### 10Y-2Y Treasury Spread

Positive = normal yield curve. Negative (inversion) historically precedes recessions by 6–18 months.

### University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment

Higher is better. Below 60 signals pessimism; above 80 signals optimism.

### Unemployment Rate

Lower is better. Rising unemployment signals economic weakness.

### Philly Fed Coincident Index [...] Leading indicator — hours cut before layoffs. Below 40 hrs signals manufacturing weakness.

### CPI All Items

Year-over-year change shown. Above 3% generally considered elevated inflation.

### Core CPI (ex Food & Energy)

Excludes food & energy. The Fed's preferred gauge of underlying inflation pressure.

### WTI Crude Oil

Directly affects jet fuel costs and airline operating expenses.
